title: Kissinger consults for the Psychological Strategy Board

tellings.quote: In 1951, 1952, and again in [music] 1955, he worked as a consultant for the Psychological Strategy Board and its [music] successor, the Operations Coordinating Board.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the American statesman Henry Kissinger worked in Washington as a consultant in 1951, 1952 and again in 1955 for the Psychological Strategy Board, a government body that planned Cold War psychological operations, and for its successor, the Operations Coordinating Board. Michels raises it while asking whether Kissinger oversaw a secret programme to recover crashed UFOs, as a sign of his early ties to secret government work.
